name: OFF Switch
description: Deactivates a specified variable when activated.

fields.name: Logic of the OFF switch
fields.description: Defines how the switch changes the target room variable when activated or deactivated.

0.name: Deactivate on Activation
0.description: Sets the target variable to 0 when the switch is activated.

1.name: Restore Previous State
1.description: Sets the target variable to 0 when activated and restores its previously stored state when deactivated.

2.name: Toggle Variable
2.description: Toggles the target variable between 0 and 1 each time the switch is activated.

3.name: Invert Activation State
3.description: Sets the target variable to 1 while the switch is deactivated and to 0 while it is activated.

4.name: Deactivate while Activated
4.description: Sets the target variable to 0 while the switch remains activated.

fields.name: Variable to be deactivated
fields.description: The local variable that will be deactivated when this OFF switch is triggered.

fields.name: Variable that activates this actor
fields.description: The local variable that triggers this OFF switch.
